subject.title: Discord DMs: inbound messages silently dropped (outbound works)

question: Should Discord account-scoped allowFrom override the global allowFrom list, merge with it, or use an explicit inheritance mode for multi-account DMs?
rationale: The linked fix would restore the reporter's global allowlist expectation but also broadens per-account authorization for users who rely on account-level allowFrom as a restriction boundary.

options.title: Keep Override Semantics
options.body: Preserve the documented security boundary and fix the user experience through clearer diagnostics or explicit per-account configuration guidance.

options.title: Merge Global And Account Lists
options.body: Treat top-level allowFrom as a true global allowlist, accepting that per-account lists can no longer narrow it without another config shape.

options.title: Add Explicit Inheritance Mode
options.body: Keep current override by default and add an intentional config or doctor-guided migration for users who want union behavior.

recommendation.title: Keep Override Semantics
recommendation.body: Preserve the documented security boundary and fix the user experience through clearer diagnostics or explicit per-account configuration guidance.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the most recent current-main ownership across the Discord docs, account merge, and shared allowlist helper touched by this decision.
